core: RNA virus genome replication and translation
qualifier: viral mRNA translation and host translation control
name: RNA virus genome replication and viral mRNA translation
rationale: All members concern intracellular replication, transcription, RNP handling and translation of RNA virus genomes (influenza, coronavirus, RSV) including host translation interference, unlike confusables centred on viral entry/assembly, RNA editing restriction or retroviral DNA integration.

name: Immunoglobulin gene diversification in B cell development
rationale: Members cover B lineage commitment, pre-B differentiation, V(D)J recombination and somatic hypermutation, distinguishing the theme from generic mismatch repair, T/B development signatures and APOBEC editing.

name: Neuron-type-specific axon pathfinding and midline chemorepulsion
rationale: All members describe axon guidance of specific neuron classes (dopaminergic, serotonergic, commissural, retinal ganglion), midline choice points and chemorepulsion, whereas confusables are defined by semaphorin, netrin, ephrin, L1 or ROBO receptor signalling cascades.

name: SLC26 and CFTR epithelial anion transport
rationale: Members are SLC26 anion exchange (iodide, sulfate, oxalate, chloride) and CFTR function and disease with transepithelial transport, distinguishing it from bicarbonate SLC4, aquaporin and SLC12 cation-chloride cotransporter themes.

qualifier: termination with nonsense, no-go and non-stop decay
name: Translation termination and nonsense, no-go, non-stop mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover translation termination and the ribosome-coupled mRNA decay routes (NMD, no-go, non-stop rescue), unlike confusables on nascent-peptide quality control, mRNA 3'-end processing or nuclear RNA processing.

name: M-CSF-driven monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell development
rationale: Members are M-CSF signalling and positive regulation of monocyte, macrophage and myeloid DC differentiation and proliferation, unlike granulocyte/G-CSF themes or negative regulation of myeloid differentiation.

name: Nucleic acid sensor-triggered IRF3/IRF7 type I interferon induction
rationale: Members describe RIG-I/MDA5, ZBP1 and TLR7/8/9 sensing leading to IRF3/IRF7 activation and interferon-alpha/beta production, distinguishing it from interferon-response, cytosolic DNA sensing and generic antiviral/viral-evasion themes.

qualifier: degron rules, ubiquitin-independent route and negative regulation
name: Proteasomal degradation via degron rules and its negative regulation
rationale: Members are N-end and C-end degron pathways, ubiquitin-independent proteasomal degradation, UCH deubiquitinases and negative regulation of proteolysis, unlike confusables on ribosome quality control, protein destabilization or stress granules.

qualifier: CNTF and IL-11 ligands, autocrine and paracrine
name: IL-6-family cytokine ligands in autocrine and paracrine signalling
rationale: Members cover IL-6-type receptor ligands (CNTF, IL-11, LIF/OSM) with autocrine/paracrine signalling, unlike confusables centred on IL-6 JAK-STAT3/ERK signalling or CSF1 receptor signalling.

name: Monocyte antigen presentation with CD1 lipid antigens and TLR7/8
rationale: Members are monocyte surface/differentiation signatures, CD1/MHC Ib lipid antigen presentation and the MHC-TLR7/8 cluster, distinguishing them from dendritic cell surface signatures and MHC class II peptide presentation themes.

name: Adrenergic control of smooth muscle contraction and relaxation
rationale: Members combine adrenoceptor/alpha-2 adenylate cyclase-inhibitory signalling with vascular, uterine, urinary and penile smooth muscle tone, unlike confusables driven by cGMP/endothelin, cardiac contractility or adenosine receptors.

qualifier: gangliosides and sialic acid/amino sugar metabolism
name: Lysosomal ganglioside catabolism and sialic acid, amino sugar metabolism
rationale: Members cover lysosomal ganglioside breakdown (HEXA/HEXB, NEU1) with sialic acid, GlcNAc and hexose phosphate metabolism, unlike confusables on glycosphingolipid synthesis, glycosaminoglycan degradation or N-glycan/GDP-mannose synthesis.

qualifier: regulation of efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
name: Regulation of cellular cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: Members regulate cholesterol efflux, reverse transport, storage, foam cell formation and biosynthesis, distinguishing it from SREBP-driven synthesis, HDL assembly/ABCA1 and lipoprotein remodelling themes.

name: ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant resistance to tyrosine kinase inhibitors
rationale: All three members are ERBB2 kinase-domain mutant drug resistance, distinguishing it from ERBB2/EGFR mutant signalling and from FGFR, PDGFR or ALK oncogenic variants.

qualifier: translesion polymerases and excision repair gap filling
name: Translesion DNA synthesis and excision repair gap filling
rationale: Members are translesion synthesis by specialized polymerases plus NER gap-filling synthesis, unlike confusables on normal replication elongation or base excision repair.

name: Viral entry, envelope protein maturation and virion assembly
rationale: Members combine virus attachment/entry with maturation of envelope, spike and accessory proteins and virion assembly/release across dengue, coronavirus, RSV and HIV, whereas each confusable has only part of this (entry or nucleoprotein maturation).

qualifier: Sertoli, Leydig and germ cell regulation
name: Testicular somatic and germ cell development
rationale: Members cover seminiferous tubule, Sertoli and Leydig cell development and germ cell proliferation/meiosis entry, unlike confusables centred on gonadotropin signalling or primordial germ cell migration.

qualifier: primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut
name: Primitive streak, lateral plate mesoderm and hindgut morphogenesis
rationale: Members span primitive streak formation, lateral plate mesoderm, mesenchyme migration and hindgut/digestive tract morphogenesis, unlike confusables on definitive endoderm, mesendoderm or cardiac mesoderm.

name: Ammonium and carbon dioxide transport by Rh glycoproteins
rationale: All three members concern Rh-glycoprotein-mediated ammonium and CO2 transmembrane transport, unlike erythrocyte gas exchange, aquaporin or bicarbonate transporter themes.

core: DNA damage response to replication stress
name: ADP-ribosylation and DNA break signalling in replication stress
rationale: Members cover DSB-site recruitment, ADP-ribosylation regulation, R-loop and DNA-protein crosslink repair and responses to camptothecin/hydroxyurea, unlike confusables on telomere maintenance, fork reversal or transcription termination.

name: Toll-like receptor IRAK-TRAF6-TAK1 activation of canonical NF-kB
rationale: Members describe TLR (MyD88/IRAK and TRIF) signalling through TRAF6/TAK1 to IKK and canonical NF-kB, unlike confusables on TAK1-JNK/p38, TNFR1 or non-canonical NF-kB signalling.

name: PDGF receptor signalling in mechanoresponsive fibroblast activation
rationale: Members are regulation of PDGFR-alpha/beta signalling and YAP/TAZ-linked fibroblast modules with hyaluronan synthesis, distinguishing it from generic ECM/stromal, TGF-beta and Hippo pathway themes.

name: Linkage-specific polyubiquitin chain assembly and deubiquitination
rationale: Members cover E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination, K6/K11/K27/K29/K48/K63 and branched chains and DUB families, unlike confusables on proteasomal degradation, protein quality control or autophagy.

name: Small GTPase activity cycling and geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members cover Rab GEFs/GAPs, Rab/protein geranylgeranylation, Ral, ARF and Rho effector signalling and GTPase activity regulation, unlike confusables on ER/Golgi vesicle trafficking and Golgi organization.

name: rRNA gene transcription and its nucleolar chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover RNA polymerase I initiation/termination and 5S rRNA transcription with chromatin regulators (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1, CSB/G9a), unlike confusables on Pol III tRNA/snRNA transcription, rRNA processing or translation initiation.
